title: Email/query: O(n log n) sort on every query, even when no sort-relevant filter
description: email/query.rs handle_email_query always calls filtered.sort_by with a key that calls parse_rfc3339_timestamp twice per comparison element pair. parse_rfc3339_timestamp calls chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339 on each call — this is a full parse with string scanning. With N entries, the sort makes O(N log N) parse calls. For a mailbox with 10,000 articles, this is ~130,000 RFC3339 parses per query. Fix: compute timestamps once into a Vec<(i64, &EmailOverviewEntry)>, sort that, then extract entries. This is also the place to fix the RFC 2822 vs RFC 3339 date format mismatch (P0 bug).
